business_scope.primary_industry_name: Stevedoring and Loading/Unloading of Bulk Cargo at Marine Docks

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (offshore financial centre administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage, codified statutes; unitary national jurisdiction without sub-state tax distinctions)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — in force 13 December 2020 — trade and economic framework with Australia, New Zealand and Pacific Islands Forum states
Samoa Agreement (EU-OACPS post-Cotonou framework), signed in Apia on 15 November 2023 — cooperation framework; not an investment-protection treaty
WTO Membership (Samoa acceded 10 May 2012) — applicable trade disciplines
Note: No standalone Samoa-China bilateral investment treaty or double tax agreement is in force; investor-protection terms are governed by the Foreign Investment Act 2000 and general contract law

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 1998, 2005, 2008 and 2018); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2007 (as amended); Proceeds of Crime Act 2000; Terrorism Suppression Act 2002; SIFA AML/CFT Compliance Guidelines and the licensing conditions imposed on international company registered agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of issuance (e.g., PRC notary office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the origin-country competent authority (China and Samoa are both Contracting States); alternatively, consular legalization at a Samoan consulate or honorary consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential or business address (utility statement or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or account-holding bank, attested by a Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization where the origin state is not an Apostille party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and financial-standing letter covering the funding of the stevedoring terminal investment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant's principal bank (signed by bank officer with bank seal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille (or consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate UBO dossier when the ultimate owner is a legal person: certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of directors and members, and certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille in the jurisdiction of issue; consular legalization if that jurisdiction is not an Apostille party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declaration (including commercial rationale for the bulk port stevedoring scope) executed before a Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille (or consular legalization)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence on foreign and domestic Politically Exposed Persons, family members and close associates under the AML/CFT Act 2007; list-based screening of directors, shareholders, UBOs, agents and counterparties against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Samoa domestic designations under the Terrorism Suppression Act 2002; adverse-media and ownership-complexity checks are required; re-screening is triggered every 180 days, on any shareholding change, or on material reputational signal.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — International Companies Registry; name-clearance applications are lodged exclusively through SIFA-licensed registered agents using SIFA's electronic filing channel (no public self-service portal for international companies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are Samoan and English (Constitution of the Independent State of Samoa 1960, Article 3). A registered IC name must be in Latin script (English or Samoan). Chinese characters have no statutory registration effect under the International Companies Act 1987; a Chinese trade name may be used in contracts only as a non-registered translation or pinyin alias. All Chinese-identity and corporate documents must be accompanied by a certified English translation for the SIFA compliance file.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Fund, Mutual Fund, Securities, Exchange, Clearing House, Credit Union, Building Society — require prior Central Bank of Samoa or SIFA licensing approval

Government, Ministry, Authority, Board, Commission, National, Reserve, Central, Public Port, Port Authority, Marine Authority — imply state or public-agency patronage; ministerial consent required or automatic refusal
Chamber of Commerce, University, Institute, College — restricted professional or educational designations
Pacific, Samoa, Offshore, International — any island or state-sovereignty reference subject to SIFA policy review
Any name identical or deceptively similar to an existing domestic or international company, trademark, or domain in Samoa
Any name contrary to public order, obscene, criminally suggestive, or implying a regulated-sector license (stevedoring, aviation, energy) without production of the corresponding license
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: SIFA's Registrar issues a written refusal citing the conflicting statutory ground or prohibited token within 5-7 business days. Step 1: within 14 calendar days the licensed registered agent may file an amended name substitution (fresh USD 75 reservation fee) to cure the objection. Step 2: the applicant may submit written legal representations through the agent to the Registrar for reconsideration; the Registrar decides within 10 business days. Step 3: on continued refusal, an administrative appeal lies to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 calendar days. Step 4: failing ministerial relief, judicial review is available in the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days. A reserved name may be renewed for successive 30-day windows only while substantive regulatory approval (e.g., Samoa Ports Authority clearance) is pending; a lapsed reservation loses priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only as the statutory registered office of the International Company at the SIFA-licensed agent's Apia address. If the IC actually performs stevedoring services within Samoa, the Samoa Ports Authority Act 1996 requires a port operator or storage licence and a physical operational base at Apia Port; a purely virtual office cannot satisfy the Samoa Ports Authority safety, security, customs, or immigration requirements. For an offshore holding IC that contracts foreign stevedoring assets without local activity, the virtual registered office structure is compliant.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 10% at the offshore holding level (SIFA or Financial Intelligence Unit inspection of the agent's CDD file during a compliance audit cycle). 100% if an operating concession for bulk terminal stevedoring at Apia Port is pursued — the Samoa Ports Authority will conduct on-site safety, equipment, and security inspections prior to issuing the operating licence.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual licence fee for international companies
Mandatory statutory appointment; prevailing market benchmark rate
Prevailing market rate (statutory requirement under the International Companies Act 1987)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; AML/CFT Act 2007 reporting-entity obligation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening (UN, OFAC, EU, domestic lists; initial plus 180-day monitoring)
Hague Apostille of notarized UBO documents (bundle of up to 5 documents in origin country)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and Competent Authority (e.g., PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing public tariff in the country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of Chinese-source identity and corporate documents (per dossier)
Samoan legal due-diligence opinion on IC charter, name-clearance and stevedoring business-scope wording
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat fee (Stage-1 pre-incorporation advisory)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss. 4, 6, 10-14 (incorporation, memorandum and articles, registered office, registered agent); Companies Act 2001 (Samoa) as subsidiary framework
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; shares may be issued with or without par value; no statutory escrow account rules apply to an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the allotment of founder shares to the subscriber is ratified and recorded in the Register of Members; (2) the registered office situated at [Address, Apia, Samoa], maintained by the licensed registered agent, is adopted as the Company's statutory office; (3) [Name A] and [Name B] are appointed Directors and [Name C] is appointed Corporate Secretary, each to serve until the next annual meeting; (4) the Directors are authorised to open bank accounts, execute port lease and stevedoring concession agreements with the Samoa Ports Authority, and apply for all environmental and operational licences required for bulk cargo terminal operations; and (5) any one Director may execute all statutory filings incidental thereto.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, MCIL (lodged through the Samoa International Finance Authority portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for reservation of the proposed International Company name in the prescribed Form IC-1, with the name containing 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' to denote limited liability. The Registrar verifies against the registered corporate names index; approval is generally issued within 2-3 working days upon clearance that the name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing entity.
required_dossiers: Written consent of the proposed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, resubmit with an alternative name after addressing the Registrar's objection notice or seek an administrative review under s. 14 of the International Companies Act 1987.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with a statutory declaration by the registered agent confirming compliance with the International Companies Act 1987, and pay the registration fee. The instrument must state the company name, registered office, registered agent, share structure and objects covering stevedoring and cargo handling services.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, amend and re-lodge the affected clauses within 14 days; if the requisition is disputed, apply to the Supreme Court of Samoa for directions under the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of fees and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the instruments, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation under the seal of the Ministry. The Company's legal existence commences on the date stated in the certificate. The certificate must be retained at the registered office and produced for bank account opening and port licensing applications.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance is delayed, apply to the Ministry's Corporate Affairs division for an urgent certificate, or seek an order of mandamus from the Supreme Court for administrative delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of registered office and engagement of registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (SIFA-regulated), registered with the Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain a physical registered office in Samoa with the licensed registered agent. The agent must hold the Company's statutory records, register of members and certificate of incorporation, and must be available to accept service of process on behalf of the Company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent resigns or is deregistered, appoint a replacement licensed agent within 30 days and file the change with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and adoption of governing resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company (as filed with the Registrar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (may be held by written resolution or electronic participation). Adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, appointment of officers, bank account opening and authorisation to pursue port and environmental licences. Minutes must be kept at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director is disqualified or fails to consent, convene an extraordinary meeting or pass a written resolution to appoint a replacement and file an updated notice of director.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Ports Authority (SPA), established under the Samoa Ports Authority Act 1995
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Port Operator Licence (Stevedoring / Bulk Cargo Handling Concession)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report required for bulk cargo terminal and stevedoring facilities under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Samoa's EIA approval conditions: zero untreated sewage discharge into harbour waters; containment of dust particulates from bulk cargo (aggregates, cement, grain) via covered conveyors and scavenging systems; hydrocarbon and suspended-solids limits for storm-water run-off; and hazardous waste handling and disposal only through MNRE-licensed contractors

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA); wharf structural load and crane capacity inspection certificate; occupational safety and health registration of the terminal workforce with MCIL under Samoa's OSH regulatory framework; workplace clearance for stevedoring operations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Maota o Lafoga), Government of Samoa — successor to the Samoa Revenue Authority and the former Inland Revenue Division of the Ministry of Finance; official online services portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (e-Tax registration, e-filing, GST returns and customs declarations). International Company licensing is administered separately by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity first files a Business and Taxpayer Registration application with the Ministry for Revenue under the Tax Administration Act 2015, providing certified charter/constitutive documents, registered office address in Samoa, director and beneficial-owner particulars, and (where relevant) a GST registration application under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2007. For an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987: (1) the company is incorporated/licensed through SIFA and the Samoa Registrar of International Companies; (2) a TIN/Tax ID is issued by the Ministry for Revenue upon registration of the IC's offshore status; (3) a Tax Exemption Certificate is obtained confirming that the IC is outside the Samoan tax charge for income tax, GST and stamp duty on offshore transactions; (4) GST registration is only obligatory if the IC commences taxable activities in Samoa with turnover exceeding WST 100,000.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa has no US-style check-the-box election; entity classification follows the International Companies Act 1987 and Income Tax Act 2015. Available statutory elections: IC tax-exempt election via SIFA (Certificate of Exemption for offshore-only International Companies, including offshore stevedoring/terminal revenues); voluntary GST registration election (s.8 GST Act 2007) for supply of domestic taxable goods/services; option to maintain a separate resident subsidiary/branch for on-island terminal operations which is taxed at entity level under the Income Tax Act 2015; no domestic hybrid-mismatch election rules are enacted, and hybrid arrangements are policed through the general anti-avoidance provisions of the Tax Administration Act 2015.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) — formerly Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST); Goods and Services Tax Act 2007
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (compulsory registration where taxable supplies in Samoa exceed or are reasonably expected to exceed WST 100,000 in any 12-month period; voluntary registration available with the Commissioner's approval). Non-resident suppliers are registrable only if they carry on a taxable activity in Samoa; offshore-only International Companies are outside the GST charge.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, fiscal-clearance, API stamping or digital-clearance regime is currently operational in Samoa. GST-registered businesses must issue compliant tax invoices (supplier name, TIN, invoice serial number, date of issue, description, GST-exclusive and GST-inclusive amounts or the 0% export statement) and file GST returns monthly or quarterly through the Ministry for Revenue e-services portal. The authority performs risk-based e-audits and data-matching against ASYCUDA World Customs export entries, bank FX flows and CRS/CbC datasets; invoice-level clearance is not yet mandated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply qualifies for the 0% GST rate if it is an export of goods (including bulk cargo loaded at a marine stevedoring terminal) with physical departure from Samoa within the statutory window; a supply of services to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply where the benefit is consumed offshore; international carriage of cargo or passengers; or ancillary supplies such as stevedoring, stevedoring supervision, dock handling and wharf services rendered under contract to a non-resident shipowner/carrier in connection with ocean-going export vessels or cargo moving between Samoa and foreign ports. The exporter/service supplier must retain conclusive evidence of the export supply, issue an export '0% GST' tax invoice, and separately disclose zero-rated supplies in the GST return to substantiate input tax credits/refunds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs / Ministry for Revenue export entry via ASYCUDA World showing ISIC 5224 stevedoring cargo, port of loading and vessel)
Ocean Bill of Lading or equivalent combined-transport document endorsed by the carrier for the bulk cargo movement
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a licensed Samoan commercial bank confirming receipt of the export proceeds in convertible foreign currency
Stevedoring service order / terminal handling agreement evidencing the supply to the non-resident customer at the 0% export rate
Samoa Ports Authority wharfage and harbour-dues invoice together with the cargo manifest reconciliation report
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Tax Administration Act 2015, the Commissioner may reopen zero-rated export claims within 36 months of the end of the return period in cases of fraud, wilful misrepresentation or evasive intent (generally 24 months for ordinary negligence). False zero-rating of a domestic supply is treated as GST evasion: shortfall penalty of up to 200% of the tax undercharged, daily late-payment interest and penalties, monetary fines of up to WST 20,000 under the GST Act 2007, imprisonment of up to 2 years, retrospective clawback of every input tax credit claimed on the false export invoice, denial/withholding of refunds until the complete customs and FX documentation bundle is produced, and referral to the Attorney General for criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), established under the Central Bank Act 1984, is the national monetary authority and the administrator of exchange control, bank licensing, and the Samoa Interbank Settlement System. Its Exchange Control Division and Financial Intelligence Unit approve capital remittance transactions and enforce AML/CFT obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is a non-internationally convertible currency and is not freely deliverable offshore; Samoan banking settlements in foreign currency are conducted in USD, EUR, AUD or NZD through the licensed bank's correspondent network. Current-account payments for genuine stevedoring, wharfage, and cargo-handling services are generally allowed if supported by commercial invoices, customs entries, and the relevant vessel documentation. Capital-account inflows and outflows, including the initial equity injection, related-party loans, repayment of shareholder debt, and periodic dividend/profit remittance, require either prior CBS exchange-control approval or a post-transaction reporting compliance process. Profit remittance to a foreign shareholder is lawful only after (i) audited statutory financial statements are available, (ii) the dividend or profit distribution satisfies Samoa's solvency and company-law requirements, (iii) any applicable dividend withholding tax is paid or certified as exempt, and (iv) the Ministry for Revenue issues a tax-clearance status on the remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For the WS_IC port-stevedoring terminal, all foreign-currency receipts arising from international vessels and cargo services are treated as export-like earnings and must be repatriated to a licensed commercial bank in Samoa within 180 days from the invoice date or the date of loading/discharge, unless a CBS-approved foreign-currency retention arrangement is obtained. There is no mandatory WST conversion percentage under Samoa's current exchange-control practice; consequently the surrender ratio is 0% of the foreign-currency receipt. Once repatriated, the stevedoring company may either retain the proceeds in a CBS-approved interest-bearing foreign-currency account or sell them to the licensed bank at the prevailing CBS reference rate to fund WST payroll, port dues, customs duties, and local tax liabilities. Any request to extend the 180-day period must be supported by the terminal service contract, an ageing schedule of receivables, and a treasury cash-flow projection.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD/WST) for inward equity injection and project capital; Operational WST Current Account and Foreign Currency Settlement Account for daily port revenue and disbursements
Operational WST Account and Foreign Currency Account; escrow structure available for capital-scope funds subject to CBS approval
Operational WST Account and restricted Foreign Currency Account; no dedicated capital-escrow product unless specifically sanctioned by head-office credit committee

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Restricted/Low. No passported EU or UK EMI licence is automatically recognised in Samoa; an offshore digital EMI may not alone be used for the WS_IC treasury because Samoan money-transfer and banking regulations require an onshore licensed bank or a licensed remitter to report transactions to the Central Bank and to clear WST obligations. A CBS-licensed money remitter may be added as an ancillary rail for small-value pre-funded beneficiary payments, but the core inbound capital and outbound trade disbursements must flow through a licensed commercial bank. The WS_IC may use an EMI only for temporary pre-funding accounts in USD/EUR where the final settlement leg is a SWIFT MT103 to the licensed bank in Samoa and no local-currency (WST) balances are held offshore.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is required in practice. At least one director or an authorised senior officer of the Samoa International Company must attend an in-person interview at the bank's Apia branch to sign the account mandate and complete the corporate KYC. Other directors and the ultimate beneficial owner may be identified through video-conference meetings and notarised/certified identification if the bank's compliance policy permits remote validation; however, a fully remote account opening is not a market-standard option for a non-resident-owned International Company. The onboarded file must include the original certificate of incorporation/registration of WS_IC, certificate of incumbency, International Company register extract, tax exemption certificate, board resolutions, trust deed (if relevant, with no bearer shares), and a current CRS/FATCA self-certification for the ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with opaque, nominee, or trust-based beneficial ownership used as the sole operator of a national port terminal.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A CBS-compliant UBO register and certificate of incumbency; full trust deed with trustee, protector, and beneficiary names (or a redacted legal opinion containing the operative sections); bank references from reputable existing banks; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; board minutes confirming operational control; and a written acknowledgement that bearer shares are prohibited.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt Samoa International Company conducting a fully operational maritime-dock business, creating substance and economic-benefit concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Samoa Ports Authority stevedoring/concession licence; Ministry for Revenue tax exemption certificate; statutory audited financial statements (or opening balance sheet audit); Apia office lease; payroll returns and pension contributions; terminal service agreements; equipment ownership or lease evidence; and an independent substance report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Stevedoring cash flows with multiple charterers, foreign vessel owners, and third-party cargo payers creating an unexplained payments matrix.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved terminal tariff schedule, each vessel agency agreement, bills of lading and cargo manifests, time-sheet/stevedore daily labour records, issued commercial invoices matching the ISIC 5224 activity, and SWIFT/sanctions screening evidence for every counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from a related family office or trust in a jurisdiction associated with financial secrecy, or an FX-purpose mismatch on transferred funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed source-of-funds trail from the originating bank and trust/family office; CRS/FATCA tax identification numbers; a Samoan legal opinion confirming that the transfer does not breach CBS exchange-control or Foreign Investment Act 2020 requirements; a foreign investment approval certificate (if applicable); and the IC's board resolution stating the precise capital purpose and expected completion timeline.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity must be routed as a SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) in USD, EUR, AUD, or NZD to the Samoan bank's correspondent account (never as WST outside Samoa), using the bank's prescribed inward-remittance purpose code for direct equity investment and adding 'EQUITY CAPITAL INJECTION / WS_IC / FOREIGN INVESTMENT APPROVAL REF / CBS REF' in Field 70. The Capital Escrow Account may only be disbursed after the Samoan bank has verified: (i) the IC's current registration and good standing with the Registrar of International Companies, (ii) the foreign-investment certificate or exemption, (iii) a certified board/shareholder resolution showing the issuance of shares and contribution amount, (iv) the CBS inward-investment notification, and (v) the source-of-funds dossier for the sending trust/bank. All supporting documents must be delivered in English or official Samoan translation, and the receiving bank will file the transaction in the CBS exchange-control and balance-of-payments statistical return.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Major import contracts for port cranes, conveyors, spare parts, and marine fuel should be settled by an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) issued by the Samoan bank, or by SWIFT MT103 T/T for smaller disbursements. Each outward remittance must clearly state the direct-investment or trade purpose classification, quote the Samoa Ministry for Revenue tax clearance for remittances, and attach the underlying term-sale contract, supplier pro-forma invoice, bill of lading/airway bill, and for LC utilizations the transport document and port receipt. Local port-authority charges, stevedoring wages, and Samoan withholding taxes are paid in WST through the onshore clearing system using the bank's electronic platform, with the resulting same-day RTGS/ACH settlement; any USD-denominated disbursement above the bank's transaction threshold must be pre-registered in the CBS reporting system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts between WS_IC and a licensed commercial bank in Samoa for WST/USD, WST/EUR, and WST/AUD tenors up to 12 months, supported by a rolling foreign-exchange exposure schedule.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing the Samoan tala, transacted with an internationally licensed bank/correspondent for hedging import payments, with USD settlement and no WST physical delivery.
Cross-currency swap (USD/WST or USD/EUR) executed with a licensed Samoan bank or its offshore parent to match the financing currency of port equipment loans with the terminal's revenue currency.

FX zero-cost collar or bought call/put options over USD/EUR/WST for the port tariff receivables, permissible when transacted through a licensed bank and reported to the CBS treasury surveillance desk for derivative exposures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) confirming registered details, members, directors, registered agent, and beneficial ownership particulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 per month or portion thereof; continued default beyond 3 months triggers a notice of intention to strike off; administrative dissolution after 6 months of persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Payment of Annual Government Licence Fee for International Company (tiered by authorised share capital band)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) on behalf of the Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 10% per month on the unpaid fee; Registrar may withhold the certificate of good standing and strike the company off the International Companies Register after 3 months of continued non-payment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Licence Renewal for Marine Stevedoring and Dock Cargo-Handling Operation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 December for the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 20% late renewal surcharge; unlicensed operation subject to daily penalty and criminal prosecution under the Business Licences Act 1998; Samoa Ports Authority may suspend terminal operating privileges

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is compulsory for a standard Samoa International Company. Mandatory independent audit applies only to ICs holding a banking, insurance, or trust business licence under the Central Bank of Samoa, or where the Registrar otherwise directs. A port stevedoring IC without such a licence is audit-exempt unless shareholder resolution, lender covenant, or port authority concession agreement requires assurance.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB where audit is required; otherwise, the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) requires accounting records sufficient to show a true and fair financial position, with no mandatory local GAAP filing to the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and record current beneficial ownership information at the registered office. Any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the register and communicated to the registered agent within 14 days; the annual return confirms particulars of members and beneficial owners as at the anniversary date. Know-your-customer evidence must be refreshed at least annually in accordance with the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2012 and SIFA AML/CFT guidance.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable for audit-exempt IC; USD 5,000 to USD 12,000 if a full IFRS audit is voluntarily engaged

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (onshore resident companies under the Income Tax Act 2015); 0% effective Samoan corporate income tax for a Samoa International Company (IC) under the statutory total tax exemption.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IC total exemption from Samoan income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, exchange control and withholding tax on outbound dividends, interest and royalties; no tax on foreign-source income earned exclusively outside Samoa; onshore preferential rate of 19% for small business companies with annual gross turnover not exceeding WST 300,000, which is unavailable to an exempt IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (Registrar of International Companies), filed online by the licensed registered agent through the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) e-registry; no corporate income tax return is filed with the Samoa Revenue Authority because the IC is statutorily tax-exempt.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; annual government fee payable with the return; the Registrar observes a grace period before imposing late penalties and may strike the company off after continued default.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered IC name, international company registration number and certificate of incorporation date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name appearing on the certificate; transliterations or trade-name variations are not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the licensed international company service provider maintaining the registered office in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Samoan-licensed registered agent is mandatory; non-resident shareholders or directors cannot act as registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address in Samoa where statutory records, the register of members and accounting books are kept.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Samoan address is required; the registered agent's office address may be adopted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities and residential addresses of all directors, alternate directors and the corporate secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted and no Samoan residency requirement applies; at least one director should be a natural person.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued capital, share classes, shareholder names and beneficial ownership particulars maintained by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: One hundred percent non-resident beneficial ownership is permitted; bearer shares are prohibited; ultimate beneficial ownership data must be disclosed to the registered agent and to authorities on lawful demand.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Samoan residents, does not own or lease Samoan land, and has not engaged in regulated domestic activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any breach converts the IC into an assessable Samoan resident company; a false declaration exposes the signing directors to criminal liability and personal assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Designation of core income-generating activities for the stevedoring and bulk cargo loading/unloading operation, physical assets in Samoa, Samoan employee headcount and place of board control.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: ISIC 5224 bulk-port operations must demonstrate genuine operational substance in Samoa; booking profits into an exempt IC without local assets and local management is a high-risk indicator.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment of the annual government fee attract automatic late penalties and loss of certificate of good standing; persistent default leads to strike-off with forfeiture of Samoan assets and reinstatement costs; knowingly false filings attract fines and imprisonment under the International Companies Act 2012.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return / Substance Declaration (Registrar of International Companies coordinating with the Samoa Revenue Authority), filed through the licensed registered agent on the MCIL e-registry platform.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed concurrently with the IC Annual Return, within six months of the financial year-end and before any non-residence or treaty protection is asserted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classification of the core income-generating activity: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, holding company, or operational maritime/port services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bulk cargo stevedoring at marine docks is an operational maritime port service; precise classification avoids an adverse nil-substance determination.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income attributable to Samoa, Samoan-source versus foreign-source income split, and the documented basis of allocation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source stevedoring revenue may be allocated to the IC only where management decisions, contracts and assets are demonstrably located in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of Samoan-resident employees, physical berth and equipment assets, local operating expenditure, and board meeting minutes evidencing Samoan management and control.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Board meetings held wholly outside Samoa do not establish Samoan management and control; minutes must record decisions taken in Samoa.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or substance non-compliance attracts fixed penalties plus daily accruals under the Samoa Economic Substance Regulations, automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, potential licence revocation and strike-off; directors and officers are personally liable for knowingly false substance declarations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for an International Company distributing dividends by virtue of the IC total tax exemption; 15% final withholding tax on dividends distributed by an onshore Samoan resident company to both resident and non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where a double taxation agreement applies under Samoa's limited treaty network, principally Australia and New Zealand, the payer must hold: (i) a Samoa Revenue Authority Certificate of Residence, (ii) a treaty relief declaration completed by the beneficial owner, and (iii) supporting beneficial ownership documentation. A tax-exempt IC normally fails the DTA residence test because it is not liable to Samoan tax; invoking treaty relief in such circumstances is a compliance red flag.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory non-resident withholding tax: interest 15%, royalties 15%; DTA provisions may reduce these rates where substantiated residence is established. Payments of interest and royalties by an exempt International Company to non-residents carry a 0% Samoan withholding rate by statutory IC exemption.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Administrative risk-based thresholds: WST 1,000,000 aggregate annual cross-border related-party transactions triggering mandatory Local File; WST 100,000,000 group-wide gross revenue triggering Master File; Samoa transfer pricing legislation applies the arm's length standard to all associated-party dealings without a statutory monetary de minimis.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa applies Economic Substance Regulations to International Companies in alignment with OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices standards. A bulk-port stevedoring IC (ISIC 5224) must maintain in Samoa physical operational assets such as berth equipment or credible subcontracted terminal presence, Samoan-resident management and employees, board meetings held in Samoa, and locally stored accounting records. Absent such substance the IC is treated as a shell, the tax exemption may be displaced, and exchange of information notifications to the foreign jurisdiction will follow.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through False IC Exemption Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the bulk-port stevedoring terminal with Samoan residents, deriving Samoan-source cargo-handling revenue, or owning or leasing Samoan land while declaring no local business in the IC Annual Return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of IC exemption; retrospective reassessment of Samoan corporate income tax at 27% on all Samoan-source revenue for the full period; tax shortfall penalty up to 100% of the evaded tax plus prescribed interest; criminal fines and strike-off under the Tax Administration Act 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the false declaration are personally assessable for the evaded tax where the corporate form is a sham; imprisonment up to five years, disqualification from directorship, travel bans during investigation, and civil restitution of diverted profits to the Crown.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking bulk-port stevedoring profits into the tax-exempt IC while all operational crews, equipment, contracts, billing and management remain in the counterparty jurisdiction; no Samoan board meetings, no Samoan employees and no local bank account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty plus daily accrual under the Samoa Economic Substance Regulations; publication of the non-compliant IC; mandatory automatic exchange of information with the foreign parent jurisdiction; revocation of the IC licence; reallocation of profits to the operational jurisdiction for tax assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed registered agent may be fined and imprisoned for knowingly lodging false substance declarations; travel restrictions apply while the inquiry is pending; directors owe fiduciary restitution to the company and creditors where assets were stripped.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing stevedoring fees through Swift/Wire or Port Authority clearing accounts to conceal beneficial ownership, evade sanctions, or launder proceeds derived from illicit cargo facilitation at the terminal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa's AML/CFT framework and Financial Intelligence Unit enforcement: freezing and forfeiture of vessels and terminal assets, fines up to WST 1,000,000 or three times the transaction value, and revocation of the payment agent licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability extends to directors, compliance officers and beneficial owners involved in structuring or false identification; penalties include imprisonment up to fourteen years, passport seizure and travel bans, and personal asset confiscation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing IC Annual Returns, economic substance declarations or withholding documentation that omit the real Samoan business connection of the bulk-port terminal or misstate beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the International Companies Act 2012 for false statements; cancellation of registration; corporate veil lifted for the entire stevedoring business; all transactions restated as onshore taxable activity subject to 27% corporate tax, penalties and interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for the full tax shortfall, legal costs and creditor claims; imprisonment for false declaration; automatic disqualification from managing any company in Samoa for ten years.
